description: This file defines the 'Model' class in the OpenCart framework, providing methods for interacting with the registry object through magic methods for get, set, and isset operations.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: A base class for models in the OpenCart framework, enabling interaction with the registry.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Model with a Registry instance.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the registry by key, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a value in the registry by key.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the registry.
